blocks.text: Q52. Monthly totals and MoM change

lines: WITH m AS (SELECT to_char(order_date,'YYYY-MM') AS month,

caption.text:
60 SQL queries to crack any data interview.

One dataset (employees, departments, orders), solved on PostgreSQL, ordered from your first SELECT to the questions interviewers actually ask.

What's inside, in order:
• Basics and Sorting
• Filtering and Simple Aggregates
• GROUP BY and HAVING
• Joins
• Multi-Table Joins and Simple Subqueries
• Correlated Subqueries and Derived Tables
• Window Functions
• Window Analytics and Basic CTEs
• CTE Patterns and Nth Highest Salary
• Real Interview Scenarios
• A cheatsheet to revise the night before

Don't just read them. Cover the answer, write the query yourself, then check.

Save this for your next prep session and send it to the friend who keeps saying they'll practice SQL.

Comment “sql” to get every query and answer as a PDF.
